programme.title: Monk
programme.sub-title: Mr. Monk and the newspaper boy / Mr. Monk und der Zeitungsjunge
programme.desc: Der Kriminalbeamte Adrian Monk wurde aufgrund seiner besonderen Fahigkeiten in seinem Beruf schnell eine kleine Beruhmtheit. Er hat ein fotografisches Gedachtnis und kann selbst aus kleinsten Hinweisen eine Spur basteln. Seit dem Tod seiner geliebten Frau Trudy durch einen mysteriosen Anschlag leidet er jedoch unter starken Ängsten und Zwangsstorungen, was zu seiner Suspendierung vom Dienst beim San Fransisco Police Department fuhrt. Nachdem er sich daraufhin drei Jahre lang in seiner Wohnung eingesperrt hat, macht er sich schlieSSlich als Privatdetektiv selbststandig und wird von der Polizei immer wieder um Unterstutzung gebeten. programme.desc: In the quiz show, a team of four candidates competes against the "Jager". This is not an easy task, because the "Jagers" are proven quiz professionals from the German quiz national team, including even the German quizmaster. In the first round, the candidates set up a game sum individually, which they have to defend together against the "Jager" in the second round to move into the final. In the final, the remaining candidates in the team compete against the "Jager" and defend the money earned so far. You have to answer as many questions as possible within two minutes. If the candidates answer more questions than the "Jager", they won. / In der Quizsendung tritt ein Team von vier Kandidaten gegen den "Jager" an. programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.desc: The Champions League in Ice Hockey is an international competition for the best European teams that has had its premiere release in the 2014/2015 season. programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football: France 2. League / Fudbal: Francuska 2. liga
programme.desc: Ligue 2 The second is on the Niou class of French club football competitions. League was founded in 1933. year and in today's format has a total of 20 clubs. The league part consists of 38 cars in which each team at home and plays with every one of the remaining clubs in the league. The two best placed teams achieve a direct placement in Ligue 1 while another three clubs through additional playing hunts another position for the placement in the elite grade of French football. The two last teams fall out in the lower rank of competition. / Ligue 2 drugi je po niou razred francuskih klupskih fudbalskih takmičenja. Liga je osnovana 1933. godine i u današnjem formatu broji ukupno 20 klubova. Ligaški deo sastoji je od 38 kola u kojima svaka ekipa kod kuće i u gostima igra sa svakim od preostalih klubova u ligi. Dve najbolje plasirane ekipe ostvaruju direktna plasman u Ligue 1 dok još tri kluba kroz dodatno razigravanje lovi još jednu poziciju za plasman u elitni razred francuskog fudbala. Dve poslednje ekipe ispadaju u niži rang takmičenja.

programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Football: France 2. League / Fudbal: Francuska 2. liga
programme.desc: Ligue 2 The second is on the Niou class of French club football competitions. League was founded in 1933. year and in today's format has a total of 20 clubs. The league part consists of 38 cars in which each team at home and plays with every one of the remaining clubs in the league. The two best placed teams achieve a direct placement in Ligue 1 while another three clubs through additional playing hunts another position for the placement in the elite grade of French football. The two last teams fall out in the lower rank of competition. / Ligue 2 drugi je po niou razred francuskih klupskih fudbalskih takmičenja. Liga je osnovana 1933. godine i u današnjem formatu broji ukupno 20 klubova. Ligaški deo sastoji je od 38 kola u kojima svaka ekipa kod kuće i u gostima igra sa svakim od preostalih klubova u ligi. Dve najbolje plasirane ekipe ostvaruju direktna plasman u Ligue 1 dok još tri kluba kroz dodatno razigravanje lovi još jednu poziciju za plasman u elitni razred francuskog fudbala. Dve poslednje ekipe ispadaju u niži rang takmičenja.

programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Hall of Fame: Stoicho Mladenov / Зала на славата: Стойчо Младенов
programme.desc: "Hall of Fame" is a section in which we present the most famous faces of the great golden galaxy of Bulgarian athletes. These significant names, which, with their success over the years, have enjoyed sports lovers in our country. In the Hall of Glory, they tell about themselves - about successes, disappointments, difficulties, peaks, about the past and the present, about sports, which plays a huge role in life and for life after sports. Thanks to the rich archive of Bulgarian National Television, you will have the opportunity to see the biggest successes of the stars of Bulgarian sport. / "Зала на славата" е рубрика, в която представяме най-известните лица от голямата златна плеяда български спортисти. Тези значими имена, които със своите успехи през годините са радвали любителите на спорта в нашата страна. В "Зала на славата" те разказват за себе си - за успехите, разочарованията, трудностите, върховете, за миналото и настоящето, за спорта, който играе огромна роля в живота и за живота след спорта. Благодарение на богатия архив на Българската национална телевизия ще имате възможност да видите и най-големите успехи на звездите на българския спорт.

programme.desc: "The Last Win" is a fun-cognitive, family quiz show involving four players. It consists of three rounds with different spheres of knowledge, in which the questions are of different point value. After the end of each round, one participant drops out, and the winner wins the right to compete in the next episode and plays until someone else is able to beat him. / "Последният печели" е забавно-познавателно, семейно куиз шоу, в което участват четирима играчи. След края на всеки кръг отпада по един участник, а победителят печели правото да се състезава и в следващия епизод и играе, докато някой друг не успее да го победи.

programme.title: Black space / Черно пространство
programme.desc: Detective David's eye worsens. Because of the pain, he is on pills and drops and walks with a bandage. It is in crisis and does not last without pills. Shaul thinks Tom has avenged his reef and will now chase him. Boys and girls constantly talk about Tom's list. Mayan threatens him. Libby goes to Dor's father, whom she met at his funeral. programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. programme.title: Football - Italian League / Nogomet - Talijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian Serie A: Highlights - (Sport. Program, Italy) Serie A is a professional football competition that has 20 teams in the two -round league championship. Since 1929, when it was founded, Serie A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football was considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and coaches. With the fall of the financial power of the Italian first -team players and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality, but returns safe steps to the place where it belongs. ... / Italian Serie A: Highlights - (sport. program, Italija) Serie A profesionalno je nogometno natjecanje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Europa Ligu. Tijekom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Rijeka - PAOK, qualifications for the Europa League 2025/2026. / Rijeka - PAOK, Kvalifikacije za Europsku ligu 2025./2026.
programme.desc: Football: UEFA Europa League Qualifiers - (Sport. Program, 2025) Europa League has a special charm given that this is the most massive competition under the auspices of Uefe. A large number of clubs are included in the qualifying process and the first meetings start at the end of June. This competition is specific because because of its abundance, it also gives "smaller" clubs to feel what it is like to play matches on the European scene. Given that the concentration of strong European clubs is primarily in the Champions League and the local championships in the Europa League, there are big surprises that prove that everyone knows how to play quality football today. Don't miss in these summer months of duel teams you can't follow every day! ... / Football: UEFA Europa League Qualifiers - (sport. program, 2025) Europa liga ima posebnu draž s obzirom da je to najmasovnije natjecanje pod okriljem UEFE. Velik broj klubova je uključen u proces kvalifikacija te prvi susreti počinju već krajem lipnja. Ovo natjecanje je specifično jer zbog svoje brojnosti daje mogućnost i "manjim" klubovima da osjete kako je to igrati utakmice na europskoj sceni. S obzirom da je koncentracija jakih europskih klubova primarno na Ligi prvaka i domaćim prvenstvima u Europa ligi dolazi do velikih iznenađenja koja dokazuju da danas svatko zna igrati kvalitetan nogomet. Nemojte propustiti u ovim ljetnim mjesecima dvoboje momčadi koje ne možete pratiti svaki dan!...

programme.title: Rudeš - Orient, SuperSport First Football League 2025/2026, 3rd round / Rudeš - Orijent, SuperSport Prva nogometna liga 2025./2026., 3. kolo
programme.desc: Football - First Croatian League - (Sport. Program, 2025) The first football league is the Croatian Football Competition of the second rank, which was founded in 1991 after the breakup of Yugoslavia. Next year, the first season was played in which the clubs were divided into four regions, and a higher ranking was progressed from each region. With numerous changes to the competition system, this league is known for developing many young players who later affirmed themselves in strong first -team players such as Dinamo, Hajduk and Rijeka ... / Football - First Croatian League - (sport. program, 2025) Prva nogometna liga je hrvatsko nogometno natjecanje drugog ranga koje je osnovano je 1991. godine nakon raspada Jugoslavije. Sljedeće godine je odigrana i prva sezona u kojoj su klubovi bili podijeljeni u četiri regije te je iz svake regije jedan klub napredovao viši rang. Uz brojne izmjene sustava natjecanja, ova liga je poznata po razvoju mnogo mladih igrača koji su se kasnije afirmirali u jakim prvoligašima kao što su Dinamo, Hajduk i Rijeka...

programme.title: Istria 1961 - Gorica, SuperSport HNL 2025/2026, 5th round / Istra 1961 - Gorica, SuperSport HNL 2025./2026., 5. kolo
programme.desc: Football - SuperSport HNL - (Sports. Program, Croatia, 2025) Follow the SuperSport Croatian Football League, the football competition of the highest rank in Croatia, which has been held since 1992 under the leadership of the Croatian Football Federation. By 2022, the league was named the first Croatian football league. The top ten football clubs from Croatia participate in the Supersport HNL. The club that is crowned with the title of national champion has the opportunity to try in the 2nd round of the UEFA Champions League, while runner -up and third -placed entering the 2nd round of qualifying for the UEFA European Conference League ... / Football - SuperSport HNL - (sport. program, Hrvatska, 2025) Pratite SuperSport hrvatsku nogometnu ligu, nogometno natjecanje najvišeg ranga u Hrvatskoj koje se održava od 1992. godine pod vodstvom Hrvatskoga nogometnog saveza. Liga je do 2022. godine nosila naziv Prva hrvatska nogometna liga. U SuperSport HNL-u sudjeluje deset najboljih nogometnih klubova iz Hrvatske. Klub koji se okruni titulom državnoga prvaka ima priliku okušati se u 2. pretkolu UEFA Lige prvaka, dok drugoplasirani i trećeplasirani ulaze u 2. pretkolo kvalifikacija za UEFA Europsku konferencijsku ligu...

programme.desc: Football: UEFA Europa League Qualifiers - (Sport. Program, 2025) Europa League has a special charm given that this is the most massive competition under the auspices of Uefe. A large number of clubs are included in the qualifying process and the first meetings start at the end of June. This competition is specific because because of its abundance, it also gives "smaller" clubs to feel what it is like to play matches on the European scene. Given that the concentration of strong European clubs is primarily in the Champions League and the local championships in the Europa League, there are big surprises that prove that everyone knows how to play quality football today. Don't miss in these summer months of duel teams you can't follow every day! ... / Football: UEFA Europa League Qualifiers - (sport. program, 2025) Europa liga ima posebnu draž s obzirom da je to najmasovnije natjecanje pod okriljem UEFE. Velik broj klubova je uključen u proces kvalifikacija te prvi susreti počinju već krajem lipnja. Ovo natjecanje je specifično jer zbog svoje brojnosti daje mogućnost i "manjim" klubovima da osjete kako je to igrati utakmice na europskoj sceni. S obzirom da je koncentracija jakih europskih klubova primarno na Ligi prvaka i domaćim prvenstvima u Europa ligi dolazi do velikih iznenađenja koja dokazuju da danas svatko zna igrati kvalitetan nogomet. Nemojte propustiti u ovim ljetnim mjesecima dvoboje momčadi koje ne možete pratiti svaki dan!...

programme.desc: Football - First Croatian League - (Sport. Next year, the first season was played in which the clubs were divided into four regions, and a higher ranking was progressed from each region. With numerous changes to the competition system, this league is known for developing many young players who later affirmed themselves in strong first -team players such as Dinamo, Hajduk and Rijeka ... / Football - First Croatian League - (sport. program, 2025) Prva nogometna liga je hrvatsko nogometno natjecanje drugog ranga koje je osnovano je 1991. godine nakon raspada Jugoslavije. Sljedeće godine je odigrana i prva sezona u kojoj su klubovi bili podijeljeni u četiri regije te je iz svake regije jedan klub napredovao viši rang. Uz brojne izmjene sustava natjecanja, ova liga je poznata po razvoju mnogo mladih igrača koji su se kasnije afirmirali u jakim prvoligašima kao što su Dinamo, Hajduk i Rijeka...

programme.desc: Football - SuperSport HNL - (Sports. Liga je do 2022. godine nosila naziv Prva hrvatska nogometna liga. U SuperSport HNL-u sudjeluje deset najboljih nogometnih klubova iz Hrvatske. Klub koji se okruni titulom državnoga prvaka ima priliku okušati se u 2. pretkolu UEFA Lige prvaka, dok drugoplasirani i trećeplasirani ulaze u 2. pretkolo kvalifikacija za UEFA Europsku konferencijsku ligu...

programme.title: PAOK - Rijeka, qualifications for the Europa League 2025/2026. / PAOK - Rijeka, Kvalifikacije za Europsku ligu 2025./2026.
programme.desc: Football: UEFA Europa League Qualifiers - (Sport. Program, 2025) Europa League has a special charm given that this is the most massive competition under the auspices of Uefe. A large number of clubs are included in the qualifying process and the first meetings start at the end of June. This competition is specific because because of its abundance, it also gives "smaller" clubs to feel what it is like to play matches on the European scene. Given that the concentration of strong European clubs is primarily in the Champions League and the local championships in the Europa League, there are big surprises that prove that everyone knows how to play quality football today. Don't miss in these summer months of duel teams you can't follow every day! ... / Football: UEFA Europa League Qualifiers - (sport. program, 2025) Europa liga ima posebnu draž s obzirom da je to najmasovnije natjecanje pod okriljem UEFE. Velik broj klubova je uključen u proces kvalifikacija te prvi susreti počinju već krajem lipnja. Ovo natjecanje je specifično jer zbog svoje brojnosti daje mogućnost i "manjim" klubovima da osjete kako je to igrati utakmice na europskoj sceni. S obzirom da je koncentracija jakih europskih klubova primarno na Ligi prvaka i domaćim prvenstvima u Europa ligi dolazi do velikih iznenađenja koja dokazuju da danas svatko zna igrati kvalitetan nogomet. Nemojte propustiti u ovim ljetnim mjesecima dvoboje momčadi koje ne možete pratiti svaki dan!...

programme.title: 40 years of live AID / 40 Jahre Live Aid
programme.desc: On July 13, 1985, the legendary benefit concert took place live AID - a music event that has campaigned for an end to famine in Africa with a lot of commitment, honest sympathy and creativity. The four -part documentation draws the impressive history of this international auxiliary movement based on archive material and current interviews - above all with main initiator Bob Geldof. Together with his colleague Midge Ure, he wrote the benefit song Do They Know Its Christmas? And convinces pop -large such as Duran Duran, Bono, George Michael and Phil Collins, to record the track free of charge and to give all income to the starving in Ethiopia. The impressive positive response to these efforts soon leads to a similar initiative in the United States. The band AID Trust is founded to also use long -term support for Africa. / Am 13. Juli 1985 fand das legendare Benefiz-Konzert Live Aid statt - ein Musikevent, das sich mit viel Engagement, ehrlicher Anteilnahme und Kreativitat fur ein Ende der Hungersnot in Afrika eingesetzt hat. Die vierteilige Dokumentation zeichnet anhand von Archivmaterial und aktuellen Interviews - allen voran mit Hauptinitiator Bob Geldof - die beeindruckende Geschichte dieser internationalen Hilfsbewegung nach.Aufgeruttelt durch eine alarmierende TV-Reportage beschlieSSt der irische Musiker Bob Geldof im spaten Oktober 1984, selbst aktiv zu werden. Zusammen mit seinem Kollegen Midge Ure verfasst er den Benefiz-Song Do They Know its Christmas? und uberzeugt PopgroSSen wie Duran Duran, Bono, George Michael und Phil Collins, den Track unentgeltlich aufzunehmen und alle Einnahmen an die Hungernden in Äthiopien zu ubergeben. Die uberwaltigend positive Resonanz auf diese Bemuhungen fuhrt alsbald zu einer ahnlichen Initiative in den Vereinigten Staaten. Der Band Aid Trust wird gegrundet, um auch langfristige Unterstutzung fur Afrika zu gewahrleisten.

programme.title: 40 years of live AID / 40 Jahre Live Aid
programme.desc: Bob Geldofs commitment makes school. Harry Belafonte and Michael Jackson initiated, gather in the 1985, including the American pop-large, under the USA for Africa label to record another benefit song. Despite the success, however, it quickly becomes clear that the collected sums hardly help. In order to save many people from starvation, Geldof starts the second part of his auxiliary program in the 1985: Under the name Live Aid, he wants to put on the bigest benefit event of all time within only five weeks - with concerts on two continents. Participating artists include David Bowie, Sting and Queen. / Bob Geldofs Einsatz macht Schule. AngestoSSen von Harry Belafonte und Michael Jackson, versammeln sich im Janner 1985 samtliche US-amerikanischen Pop-GroSSen unter dem Label USA for Africa, um einen weiteren Benefiz-Song einzuspielen. Trotz des Erfolgs wird jedoch schnell klar, dass die gesammelten Summen kaum weiterhelfen. Um moglichst viele Menschen vor dem Hungertod zu retten, startet Geldof im Fruhjahr 1985 den zweiten Teil seines Hilfsprogramms: Unter dem Namen Live Aid will er innerhalb von nur funf Wochen die groSSte Benefiz-Veranstaltung aller Zeiten auf die Beine stellen - mit Konzerten auf zwei Kontinenten. programme.title: Eco Spezial
programme.sub-title: Putin's fleet - Russian espionage in the Baltic Sea / Putins Flotte - russische Spionage in der Ostsee
programme.desc: The fate of Ukraine is being negotiated between the United States, Europe and Russia. The West hopes for peace with sufficient security guarantees for Ukraine. Nevertheless, Russia is not only provoking with massive night drone attacks on Kiev, but also with a war drone that has been lined up by Uber Polish territory. For more than a year, Russia has been testing NATO in the Baltic Sea with ships. Healthy Europe has been vulnerable. Here are the modern lifeline: pipelines, power lines and data cables. If they are destroyed, millions of households could no longer be cared for, and the explosion of the North Stream pipelines three years ago was considered a warning shot. At that time, politicians from all over Europe emphasized the need to better use critical infrastructure. The offshore wind farms, the performance of which should grow enormously in the coming decades, are part of this vital infrastructure. In the nearby pipelines and cables, ships are repeatedly seen under Russian flag that have switched off their location systems and want to remain undetected. You are interested in everything that lies on the sea floor. A whole armada old tanker makes the Baltic Sea unsafe. It is not just about Russian oil, but also about espionage and hybrid war altitude. In the North and Baltic Sea, more than 60 particularly suspicious activities of critical infrastructure could be identified, such as very slow sneak trips and zigzag courses. What is the secret mission of the ships? Why do you drive without position data and have armed special forces on board? And why is it so difficult for the police and militar to act against the mysterious ships? Eco-special from the NDR. Report: Marie Blocher, Antonius Kempmann and Benedikt Strunz. / Das Schicksal der Ukraine wird gerade zwischen den USA, Europa und Russland verhandelt. Der Westen hofft auf einen Frieden mit ausreichenden Sicherheitsgarantien fur die Ukraine. Dennoch provoziert Russland nicht nur mit massiven nachtlichen Drohnenangriffen auf Kiew, sondern unter anderem mit einer Kriegsdrohne, die uber polnischem Staatsgebiet abgesturzt ist. Schon seit mehr als einem Jahr wird von Russland in der Ostsee die Abwehr der NATO mit Schiffen getestet.Verborgen am Meeresgrund ist Europa verwundbar. Hier liegen die modernen Lebensadern: Pipelines, Stromleitungen und Datenkabel. Werden sie zerstort, konnten Millionen Haushalte nicht mehr versorgt werden.Die Explosion der Nord-Stream-Pipelines vor drei Jahren galt vielen als Warnschuss. Politiker aus ganz Europa betonten damals die Notwendigkeit, kritische Infrastruktur musse besser geschutzt werden. Auch die Offshore-Windparks, deren Leistung in den kommenden Jahrzehnten enorm wachsen soll, sind Teil dieser lebenswichtigen Infrastruktur.In der Nahe von Pipelines und Kabeln werden immer wieder Schiffe unter russischer Flagge gesehen, die ihre Ortungssysteme abgeschaltet haben und unentdeckt bleiben wollen. Sie interessieren sich fur all das, was am Meeresboden liegt. Eine ganze Armada alter Tanker macht also die Ostsee unsicher. Es geht dabei nicht nur um russisches Öl, sondern auch um Spionage und hybride Kriegsfuhrung.Der Norddeutsche Rundfunk (NDR) zahlte bei einer Recherche dutzende Durchfahrten. In Nord- und Ostsee konnten auSSerdem mehr als 60 besonders verdachtige Aktivitaten uber kritischer Infrastruktur identifiziert werden, wie etwa ganz langsame Schleichfahrten und Zickzackkurse.Was ist die geheime Mission der Schiffe? Warum fahren sie haufig ohne Positionsdaten und haben bewaffnete Spezialkrafte an Bord? Und wieso fallt es Polizei und Militar so schwer, gegen die mysteriosen Schiffe vorzugehen?ECO-Spezial vom NDR.Bericht: Marie Blocher, Antonius Kempmann und Benedikt Strunz.

programme.title: Philosophisches Forum
programme.sub-title: Love, passion and marriage - how does relationship work today? / Liebe, Leidenschaft und Ehe - Wie geht Beziehung heute?
programme.desc: The longing for close, security and a shared life of life exists. Even people over 70 still hope for great love. The freedom of our time also brings great challenges for pleasure and love questions: How do self-optimization and dating apps invent our attachment- and our picture of love? What is love at all? And does it also need the institution of marriage? -BARBARA Stockl and Konrad Paul Liessmann in the "Philosophical Forum" with*) Emilia Roig (political scientist),*) Robert Pfaller (philosopher),*) Martina Leibovici-Muhlberger (doctor and psychotherapist),*) Cornelia Mooslechner-Broll (philosophical practitioner),*) Martin Lintner (moral theologist). / Die Sehnsucht nach Nahe, Geborgenheit und einem gemeinsamen Lebensentwurf besteht alters- und generationenubergreifend. Selbst Menschen uber 70 hoffen noch auf die groSSe Liebe. Die Freiheit unserer Zeit bringt zugleich groSSe Herausforderungen fur Lust- und Liebesfragen: Wie verandern Selbstoptimierung und Dating-Apps unsere Bindungsfahigkeit - und unser Bild von Liebe? Was ist Liebe uberhaupt? Und braucht es dazu noch die Institution der Ehe? - Daruber reden Barbara Stockl und Konrad Paul Liessmann im "Philosophischen Forum" mit*) Emilia Roig (Politologin),*) Robert Pfaller (Philosoph),*) Martina Leibovici-Muhlberger (Ärztin und Psychotherapeutin),*) Cornelia Mooslechner-Brull (Philosophische Praktikerin),*) Martin Lintner (Moraltheologe).

programme.title: Heute heiratet mein Mann
programme.desc: Caroline and Robert are happily and satisfied. Robert's upcoming wedding throws more off the track than she thought. Und wieso ist er eifersuchtig auf diesen Mann, der sich neuerdings an Carolines Seite tummelt? Und wahrend Roberts Zukunftige die Feierlichkeiten organisiert, driften Caroline und Robert immer mehr aufeinander zu. Aber: Hat das Aufwallen alter Gefuhle wirklich etwas zu bedeuten.....?

Auch die Offshore-Windparks, deren Leistung in den kommenden Jahrzehnten enorm wachsen soll, sind Teil dieser lebenswichtigen Infrastruktur.In der Nahe von Pipelines und Kabeln werden immer wieder Schiffe unter russischer Flagge gesehen, die ihre Ortungssysteme abgeschaltet haben und unentdeckt bleiben wollen. Sie interessieren sich fur all das, was am Meeresboden liegt. Eine ganze Armada alter Tanker macht also die Ostsee unsicher. Es geht dabei nicht nur um russisches Öl, sondern auch um Spionage und hybride Kriegsfuhrung.Der Norddeutsche Rundfunk (NDR) zahlte bei einer Recherche dutzende Durchfahrten. In Nord- und Ostsee konnten auSSerdem mehr als 60 besonders verdachtige Aktivitaten uber kritischer Infrastruktur identifiziert werden, wie etwa ganz langsame Schleichfahrten und Zickzackkurse.Was ist die geheime Mission der Schiffe? Warum fahren sie haufig ohne Positionsdaten und haben bewaffnete Spezialkrafte an Bord? Und wieso fallt es Polizei und Militar so schwer, gegen die mysteriosen Schiffe vorzugehen?ECO-Spezial vom NDR.Bericht: Marie Blocher, Antonius Kempmann und Benedikt Strunz.

programme.title: 3 1/2 hours / 3 1/2 Stunden
programme.desc: In the summer of 1961, the GDR design strengthened its barrier measures. A wall is pulled up between East and West Berlin, windows are barricaded, each loophole is closed. The film is gripping the fateful hours based on a group of GDR burden who want to travel by train from Munchen to East Berlin when they reached the news from the rigid border regime Munchen, August 13, 1961: An interzone train moves towards East Berlin. Nobody still guesses what difficult decision everyone will soon face. The GDR government raises a wall, East Berlin is sealed off. The travelers still have three and a half hours to get out in the west before the Grenzuertrieben. Their decision will have families apart, promising careers dangerous and is not least dependent on the train staff. Edith Salzmann, one of the first locomotives of the GDR, is said to bring the train over the hard border. / Im Sommer 1961 verstarkt die DDR-Fuhrung ihre AbsperrungsmaSSnahmen. Eine Mauer wird zwischen Ost- und Westberlin hochgezogen, Fenster werden verbarrikadiert, jedes Schlupfloch geschlossen. Packend erzahlt der Film die schicksalsentscheidenden Stunden anhand einer Gruppe von DDR-Burgerinnen und Burgern nach, die mit dem Zug von Munchen nach Ost-Berlin reisen wollen, als sie die Nachricht vom rigiden Grenzregime erreicht.Bahnhof Munchen, 13. August 1961: Ein Interzonenzug setzt sich Richtung Ost-Berlin in Bewegung. Noch ahnt niemand, vor welch schwierigen Entscheidung alle bald stehen werden. Die DDR-Regierung zieht eine Mauer hoch, Ost-Berlin wird abgeriegelt. Noch dreieinhalb Stunden haben die Reisenden Zeit, um vor dem Grenzubertritt im Westen auszusteigen. Ihre Entscheidung wird Familien auseinanderreiSSen, vielversprechende Karrieren gefahrden und ist nicht zuletzt vom Zugspersonal abhangig. Edith Salzmann, eine der ersten Lokfuhrerinnen der DDR, soll den Zug uber die harte Grenze bringen.

programme.title: WeltWeit
programme.sub-title: Agriculture in change. Does the future of genetic engineering belong? / Landwirtschaft im Wandel. Gehort die Zukunft der Gentechnik?
programme.desc: The use of genetic engineering in agriculture is still controversial after almost 30 years. In addition to environmental concerns and the monopoly position of some fewer seed manufacturers, critics drove the long-term consequences to be tapped. In Europe, many consumers vehemently reject "genetic engineering on the plate". The cultivation of genetically connected plants has been cut in the EU, and in Austria they still have not come to the fields. The large agricultural -producing countries such as the USA, Canada, Brazil or India, on the other hand, rely flatly on it: worldwide generous plants are grown on around 200 million hectares of hectares. Minged into the genome, which means that plants become more resistant to climate extremes and males more resistance and their cultivation is less stressful. For some young farmers it is clear: in the future, agriculture does not have to contradict nature. After a few Durresommern, they were used more resistant NGT corn. But there is worry that in addition to the dependency on seed companies NGT seeds at the end of the day will be too expensive for small farmers. USA correspondent Thomas Langpaul is on local inspection in Oklahoma. The state in the country's central Suden pays to the fuided wheat producers and is one of the hotspots of the American agricultural industry. In addition to wheat, corn, soy and cotton is grown on the huge farms that still rely on classic genetic engineering (GMO). But here too, a rethink begins, because the consequences of climate change - such as extreme dur periods, soil erosion and thus falling streak - also present the large companies with enormous challenges. In 2021, the government dares an experiment: the entire country is to be switched to biological agriculture. Instead of a gradual transition, import and use of synthetic dung agents and pesticides are banned almost over night. Within a few months, the harvesting carrier breaks down drastically, the food prices shoot into the high, protests shocks the country. Correspondent Benedict Feichtner meets peasant families who have lost their livelihood as a result of the abrupt change. In the meantime, imported seeds and chemical sprays have been approved again, but at the same time a kind of countermovement has arisen: in training centers, small farmers learn today how they can sustainably operate organic farming using traditional and regenerative methods and thus escape the dependency on the large seed corporations. / Der Einsatz von Gentechnik in der Landwirtschaft ist - nach inzwischen fast 30 Jahren - immer noch umstritten. Kritiker fuhren neben Umweltbedenken und der Monopolstellung einiger weniger Saatgut-Hersteller vor allem die schwer abzuschatzenden Langzeitfolgen ins Treffen. In Europa lehnen viele Verbraucher "Gentechnik am Teller" vehement ab. Der Anbau gentechnisch veranderter Pflanzen ist in der EU stark eingeschrankt, in Österreich kommen sie bis heute nicht auf die Felder. Die groSSen agrarproduzierenden Lander wie die USA, Kanada, Brasilien oder auch Indien setzen hingegen flachendeckend darauf: weltweit werden auf rund 200 Millionen Hektar genmodifizierte Pflanzen angebaut.In Belgien spricht Korrespondent Johannes Perterer mit Wissenschaftlerinnen, die NGT - also die "Neue Gentechnik" - als groSSe Chance sehen: mit Entwicklungen wie der sogenannten "Genschere" sind prazisere Eingriffe ins Erbgut moglich, wodurch Pflanzen kunftig widerstandsfahiger gegen Klimaextreme und Schadlinge werden und ihr Anbau die Boden weniger belastet. Fur einige junge Bauern steht fest: in Zukunft muss Landwirtschaft nicht im Widerspruch zur Natur stehen. Nach einigen Durresommern wurden sie resistenteren NGT-Mais einsetzen. Doch es bleibt die Sorge, dass neben der Abhangigkeit von Saatgutkonzernen NGT-Saatgut am Ende des Tages fur kleine Bauern zu teuer sein wird.USA-Korrespondent Thomas Langpaul ist auf Lokalaugenschein in Oklahoma unterwegs. Der Bundesstaat im zentralen Suden des Landes zahlt zu den fuhrenden Weizenproduzenten und ist einer der Hotspots der amerikanischen Agrarindustrie. Auf den riesigen Farmen, die nach wie vor auf die klassische Gentechnik (GMO) setzen, wird neben Weizen vor allem Mais, Soja und Baumwolle angebaut. Doch auch hier beginnt ein Umdenken, denn die Folgen des Klimawandels - wie extreme Durreperioden, Bodenerosion und damit sinkende Ertrage - stellen auch die GroSSbetriebe vor enorme Herausforderungen.In Sri Lanka wagt die Regierung 2021 ein Experiment: das gesamte Land soll auf biologische Landwirtschaft umgestellt werden. Anstatt eines schrittweisen Überganges werden Einfuhr und Verwendung synthetischer Dungemittel und Pestizide quasi uber Nacht verboten. Binnen weniger Monate brechen die Ernteertrage drastisch ein, die Lebensmittelpreise schieSSen in die Hohe, Proteste erschuttern das Land. Korrespondent Benedict Feichtner trifft Bauernfamilien, die als Folge des abrupten Umstiegs ihre Existenzgrundlage verloren haben. Inzwischen sind importiertes Saatgut und chemische Spritzmittel wieder zugelassen, doch gleichzeitig ist eine Art Gegenbewegung entstanden: in Schulungszentren lernen Kleinbauern heute, wie sie mit traditionellen und regenerativen Methoden Bio-Landwirtschaft nachhaltig betreiben und so aus der Abhangigkeit von den groSSen Saatgut-Konzernen entkommen konnen.

programme.desc: For over 1000 years, people from all over the world have had a pilgrimage to the Wolfgangsee to follow the traces of St. Wolfgang and drink on his healing source or to drop "miracle water". The pilgrimage passed the culture and economy of the region around the Abersee, as the Wolfgangsee originated originally. Gastricifications, breweries, gingerbread manufacturers, drives and glass huts already developed at the time, because the pilgrims wanted to be cared for, just like the numerous tourists from today. / Seit uber 1000 Jahren pilgern Menschen aus aller Welt an den Wolfgangsee, um den Spuren des Heiligen Wolfgang zu folgen und an seiner Heilquelle zu trinken oder "Wunderwasser" abzufullen. Sie bewundern seine Kirche in St. Wolfgang mit dem beruhmten Michael Pacher-Altar - er zeigt die Wolfganglegende - und bitten um BuSSe und Heilung.Die Pilgerfahrt pragte die Kultur und Wirtschaft der Region rund um den Abersee, wie der Wolfgangsee ursprunglich geheiSSen hat. Gastwirtschaften, Brauereien, Lebkuchenherstellern, Fahrbetrieben und Glashutten entwickelten sich bereits damals, denn die Pilgerreisenden wollten versorgt sein, genauso wie die zahlreichen Touristinnen und Touristen von heute.Peter Beringer begibt sich auf eine spannende Spurensuche nach dem Heiligen Wolfgang und seiner Wirkung auf die Menschen und die Landschaft.

programme.title: Tiroler Bauernhauser - Zwischen Romantik und Realitat
programme.desc: "As soon as the flies revolve around the soup, the romanticism at the farm catches up," says Tyrolean farmer and actor Tobias Moretti. With his wife Julia, he manages an old farm near Innsbruck. "We voluntarily bought hard work," says the passionate farmer Julia Moretti. 30 years ago, 700 powdery ensembles were preserved in Tyrol, today there are just 80. For this riveting result there is a study carried out by the Tyrolean art cadastre. Julia Moretti is committed to the "Langenfeld explanation" as an ambassador for the "Landliche Baukultur. But what does an active farmer do with an old farm who is a listed building and who is difficult to manage with a modern tractor? Teresa Andreae, the designer of the documentary, visited several historical farmers' farm in North and East Tyrol with her team and shows in Austria, picture "Tiroler Bauernhauser - between romanticism and reality" which different forms of continued life are possible. / "Sobald die Fliegen aus dem Stall um die Suppe kreisen, hort sich die Romantik am Bauernhof auf", sagt der Tiroler Bauer und Schauspieler Tobias Moretti. Er bewirtschaftet mit seiner Frau Julia einen alten Hof in der Nahe von Innsbruck. "Wir haben uns freiwillig harte Arbeit gekauft", sagt die leidenschaftliche Bauerin Julia Moretti. Vor 30 Jahren waren in Tirol noch 700 bauerliche Ensembles erhalten, heute sind es gerade noch 80. Zu diesem aufruttelnden Ergebnis kommt eine vom Tiroler Kunstkataster durchgefuhrte Studie. Julia Moretti engagiert sich als Botschafterin fur die "Langenfelder Erklarung", das ist ein Pladoyer fur den Erhalt von landlicher Baukultur. Doch was tut ein aktiver Bauer mit einem alten Hof, der unter Denkmalschutz steht, und der sich mit einem modernen Traktor nur schwer bewirtschaften lasst? Teresa Andreae, die Gestalterin der Dokumentation, hat mit ihrem Team mehrere historische Bauernhofe in Nord- und Osttirol besucht und zeigt im Österreich Bild am Feiertag "Tiroler Bauernhauser - Zwischen Romantik und Realitat" welche unterschiedlichen Formen des Weiterlebens moglich sind.

programme.title: Traumschlosser und Ritterburgen
programme.desc: From Strudengau to the upper Muhlviertel - the castles and locksmith in the Oberosterreiche Danube region are preserved by their owners with foresight for the coming generations.1822 the Saxony -Coburg and Gotha Schloss Greinburg have acquired in Grein an der Donau. Erbprinz Hubertus von Sachsen-Coburg and Gotha visits the oldest residential castle in Austria several times a month. Further west is the alleged oldest city in Austria: Enns. Parts of the Castle Ennsegg. Just a few kilometers from the state capital Linz, the castle of the same name is located in the municipality of Steygg, on which Niklas Salm-Reifferscheidt has headed the forest and estate administration since 2009. Starhemberg Castle has been owned by the Starhemberg family in Eferding west of Linz for around 450 years. Today it houses the family museum and the museum of the city of Eferding, and it is the residence of today's owner Georg Adam Starhemberg. Altenhof Castle in the Upper Muhlviertel once hired as well as the Falkenstein Castle in the immediate vicinity to rule the powerful Falkensteiner. Schloss Altenhof and the Ruin Falkenstein have been owned by the Counts Salburg-Falkenstein for over 400 years. / Vom Strudengau bis ins Obere Muhlviertel - die Burgen und Schlosser in der oberosterreichischen Donauregion werden von ihren Besitzerinnen und Besitzern mit Weitblick fur die kommenden Generationen bewahrt.1822 hat die Familie Sachsen-Coburg und Gotha Schloss Greinburg in Grein an der Donau erworben. Erbprinz Hubertus von Sachsen-Coburg und Gotha besucht das alteste Wohnschloss Österreichs mehrmals im Monat. Weiter westlich befindet sich die vorgeblich alteste Stadt Österreichs: Enns. Als Teil der Stadtbefestigung dienten einst Teile der Anlage von Schloss Ennsegg. Nur wenige Kilometer von der Landeshauptstadt Linz entfernt befindet sich in der Stadtgemeinde Steyregg das gleichnamige Schloss, auf dem Niklas Salm-Reifferscheidt seit 2009 die Forst- und Gutsverwaltung leitet. Seit rund 450 Jahren ist Schloss Starhemberg in Eferding westlich von Linz im Besitz der furstlichen Familie Starhemberg. Heute beherbergt es das Familienmuseum, sowie das Museum der Stadt Eferding, und es ist der Wohnsitz des heutigen Besitzers Georg Adam Starhemberg. Schloss Altenhof im Oberen Muhlviertel gehorte einst wie auch die in der unmittelbaren Umgebung gelegene Burg Falkenstein zur Herrschaft der machtigen Falkensteiner. Seit uber 400 Jahren sind Schloss Altenhof und die Ruine Falkenstein im Besitz der Grafen Salburg-Falkenstein.

programme.title: Eco Spezial
programme.sub-title: Putin's fleet - Russian espionage in the Baltic Sea / Putins Flotte - russische Spionage in der Ostsee
programme.desc: The fate of Ukraine is being negotiated between the United States, Europe and Russia. The West hopes for peace with sufficient security guarantees for Ukraine. Nevertheless, Russia is not only provoking with massive night drone attacks on Kiev, but also with a war drone that has been lined up by Uber Polish territory. For more than a year, Russia has been testing NATO in the Baltic Sea with ships. Healthy Europe has been vulnerable. Here are the modern lifeline: pipelines, power lines and data cables. If they are destroyed, millions of households could no longer be cared for, and the explosion of the North Stream pipelines three years ago was considered a warning shot. At that time, politicians from all over Europe emphasized the need to better use critical infrastructure. The offshore wind farms, the performance of which should grow enormously in the coming decades, are part of this vital infrastructure. In the nearby pipelines and cables, ships are repeatedly seen under Russian flag that have switched off their location systems and want to remain undetected. You are interested in everything that lies on the sea floor. A whole armada old tanker makes the Baltic Sea unsafe. It is not just about Russian oil, but also about espionage and hybrid war altitude. In the North and Baltic Sea, more than 60 particularly suspicious activities of critical infrastructure could be identified, such as very slow sneak trips and zigzag courses. What is the secret mission of the ships? Why do you drive without position data and have armed special forces on board? And why is it so difficult for the police and militar to act against the mysterious ships? Eco-special from the NDR. Report: Marie Blocher, Antonius Kempmann and Benedikt Strunz. / Das Schicksal der Ukraine wird gerade zwischen den USA, Europa und Russland verhandelt. Der Westen hofft auf einen Frieden mit ausreichenden Sicherheitsgarantien fur die Ukraine. Dennoch provoziert Russland nicht nur mit massiven nachtlichen Drohnenangriffen auf Kiew, sondern unter anderem mit einer Kriegsdrohne, die uber polnischem Staatsgebiet abgesturzt ist. Schon seit mehr als einem Jahr wird von Russland in der Ostsee die Abwehr der NATO mit Schiffen getestet.Verborgen am Meeresgrund ist Europa verwundbar. Hier liegen die modernen Lebensadern: Pipelines, Stromleitungen und Datenkabel. Werden sie zerstort, konnten Millionen Haushalte nicht mehr versorgt werden.Die Explosion der Nord-Stream-Pipelines vor drei Jahren galt vielen als Warnschuss. Politiker aus ganz Europa betonten damals die Notwendigkeit, kritische Infrastruktur musse besser geschutzt werden. Auch die Offshore-Windparks, deren Leistung in den kommenden Jahrzehnten enorm wachsen soll, sind Teil dieser lebenswichtigen Infrastruktur.In der Nahe von Pipelines und Kabeln werden immer wieder Schiffe unter russischer Flagge gesehen, die ihre Ortungssysteme abgeschaltet haben und unentdeckt bleiben wollen. Sie interessieren sich fur all das, was am Meeresboden liegt. Eine ganze Armada alter Tanker macht also die Ostsee unsicher. Es geht dabei nicht nur um russisches Öl, sondern auch um Spionage und hybride Kriegsfuhrung.Der Norddeutsche Rundfunk (NDR) zahlte bei einer Recherche dutzende Durchfahrten. In Nord- und Ostsee konnten auSSerdem mehr als 60 besonders verdachtige Aktivitaten uber kritischer Infrastruktur identifiziert werden, wie etwa ganz langsame Schleichfahrten und Zickzackkurse.Was ist die geheime Mission der Schiffe? Warum fahren sie haufig ohne Positionsdaten und haben bewaffnete Spezialkrafte an Bord? Und wieso fallt es Polizei und Militar so schwer, gegen die mysteriosen Schiffe vorzugehen?ECO-Spezial vom NDR.Bericht: Marie Blocher, Antonius Kempmann und Benedikt Strunz.

programme.title: Philosophisches Forum
programme.sub-title: Love, passion and marriage - how does relationship work today? / Liebe, Leidenschaft und Ehe - Wie geht Beziehung heute?
programme.desc: The longing for close, security and a shared life of life exists. Even people over 70 still hope for great love. The freedom of our time also brings great challenges for pleasure and love questions: How do self-optimization and dating apps invent our attachment- and our picture of love? What is love at all? And does it also need the institution of marriage? -BARBARA Stockl and Konrad Paul Liessmann in the "Philosophical Forum" with*) Emilia Roig (political scientist),*) Robert Pfaller (philosopher),*) Martina Leibovici-Muhlberger (doctor and psychotherapist),*) Cornelia Mooslechner-Broll (philosophical practitioner),*) Martin Lintner (moral theologist). / Die Sehnsucht nach Nahe, Geborgenheit und einem gemeinsamen Lebensentwurf besteht alters- und generationenubergreifend. Selbst Menschen uber 70 hoffen noch auf die groSSe Liebe. Die Freiheit unserer Zeit bringt zugleich groSSe Herausforderungen fur Lust- und Liebesfragen: Wie verandern Selbstoptimierung und Dating-Apps unsere Bindungsfahigkeit - und unser Bild von Liebe? Was ist Liebe uberhaupt? Und braucht es dazu noch die Institution der Ehe? - Daruber reden Barbara Stockl und Konrad Paul Liessmann im "Philosophischen Forum" mit*) Emilia Roig (Politologin),*) Robert Pfaller (Philosoph),*) Martina Leibovici-Muhlberger (Ärztin und Psychotherapeutin),*) Cornelia Mooslechner-Brull (Philosophische Praktikerin),*) Martin Lintner (Moraltheologe).

programme.title: Eco Spezial
programme.sub-title: Putin's fleet - Russian espionage in the Baltic Sea / Putins Flotte - russische Spionage in der Ostsee
programme.desc: The fate of Ukraine is being negotiated between the United States, Europe and Russia. The West hopes for peace with sufficient security guarantees for Ukraine. Nevertheless, Russia is not only provoking with massive night drone attacks on Kiev, but also with a war drone that has been lined up by Uber Polish territory. For more than a year, Russia has been testing NATO in the Baltic Sea with ships. Healthy Europe has been vulnerable. Here are the modern lifeline: pipelines, power lines and data cables. If they are destroyed, millions of households could no longer be cared for, and the explosion of the North Stream pipelines three years ago was considered a warning shot. At that time, politicians from all over Europe emphasized the need to better use critical infrastructure. The offshore wind farms, the performance of which should grow enormously in the coming decades, are part of this vital infrastructure. In the nearby pipelines and cables, ships are repeatedly seen under Russian flag that have switched off their location systems and want to remain undetected. You are interested in everything that lies on the sea floor. A whole armada old tanker makes the Baltic Sea unsafe. It is not just about Russian oil, but also about espionage and hybrid war altitude. In the North and Baltic Sea, more than 60 particularly suspicious activities of critical infrastructure could be identified, such as very slow sneak trips and zigzag courses. What is the secret mission of the ships? Why do you drive without position data and have armed special forces on board? And why is it so difficult for the police and militar to act against the mysterious ships? Eco-special from the NDR. Report: Marie Blocher, Antonius Kempmann and Benedikt Strunz. / Das Schicksal der Ukraine wird gerade zwischen den USA, Europa und Russland verhandelt. Der Westen hofft auf einen Frieden mit ausreichenden Sicherheitsgarantien fur die Ukraine. Dennoch provoziert Russland nicht nur mit massiven nachtlichen Drohnenangriffen auf Kiew, sondern unter anderem mit einer Kriegsdrohne, die uber polnischem Staatsgebiet abgesturzt ist. Schon seit mehr als einem Jahr wird von Russland in der Ostsee die Abwehr der NATO mit Schiffen getestet.Verborgen am Meeresgrund ist Europa verwundbar. Hier liegen die modernen Lebensadern: Pipelines, Stromleitungen und Datenkabel. Werden sie zerstort, konnten Millionen Haushalte nicht mehr versorgt werden.Die Explosion der Nord-Stream-Pipelines vor drei Jahren galt vielen als Warnschuss. Politiker aus ganz Europa betonten damals die Notwendigkeit, kritische Infrastruktur musse besser geschutzt werden. Auch die Offshore-Windparks, deren Leistung in den kommenden Jahrzehnten enorm wachsen soll, sind Teil dieser lebenswichtigen Infrastruktur.In der Nahe von Pipelines und Kabeln werden immer wieder Schiffe unter russischer Flagge gesehen, die ihre Ortungssysteme abgeschaltet haben und unentdeckt bleiben wollen. Sie interessieren sich fur all das, was am Meeresboden liegt. Eine ganze Armada alter Tanker macht also die Ostsee unsicher. Es geht dabei nicht nur um russisches Öl, sondern auch um Spionage und hybride Kriegsfuhrung.Der Norddeutsche Rundfunk (NDR) zahlte bei einer Recherche dutzende Durchfahrten. In Nord- und Ostsee konnten auSSerdem mehr als 60 besonders verdachtige Aktivitaten uber kritischer Infrastruktur identifiziert werden, wie etwa ganz langsame Schleichfahrten und Zickzackkurse.Was ist die geheime Mission der Schiffe? Warum fahren sie haufig ohne Positionsdaten und haben bewaffnete Spezialkrafte an Bord? Und wieso fallt es Polizei und Militar so schwer, gegen die mysteriosen Schiffe vorzugehen?ECO-Spezial vom NDR.Bericht: Marie Blocher, Antonius Kempmann und Benedikt Strunz.

programme.title: 3 at the round table / 3 Am Runden Tisch
The construction of the Berlin Wall - Countdown 61 / Der Bau der Berliner Mauer - Countdown 61
programme.desc: August 13, 1961. In the early hours, the construction of the Berlin Wall begins, which will share Germany for almost 30 years. They tore families and destroyed life. Those who wanted to overcome them risk their life. The construction of the Berlin Wall was preceded by a real countdown, in which Eastern and Westmacht recently opposed in a dramatic nerve test. Even millions of people had been chilled from the GDR to the West. The prehistory of the strictly secret wall is a crime thriller and failed diplomatic tremor. Sandnerlooksfilm, ZDFinfobung: Sabine Assmann / 13.August 1961. In den fruhen Morgenstunden beginnt der Bau der Berliner Mauer, die Deutschland fur fast 30 Jahre teilen wird. Sie zerriss Familien und zerstorte Leben. Wer sie uberwinden wollte, riskierte sein Leben. Dem Bau der Berliner Mauer ging ein regelrechter Countdown voraus, bei dem sich Ost- und Westmachte zuletzt in einer dramatischen Nervenprobe gegenuberstanden. Schon Millionen Menschen waren aus der DDR in den Westen gefluchtet. Die Vorgeschichte des streng geheimen Mauerbaus ist ein Krimi aus Lugen und gescheiterten diplomatischen Bemuhungen.Die "Universum History"-Dokumentation "Der Bau der Berliner Mauer - Countdown 61" von Henrike Sandner beleuchtet das Jahr vor diesem Meilenstein der deutsch-deutschen Geschichte vollig neu - aus der personlichen Perspektive von Zeitzeuginnen und Zeitzeugen.Regie: Henrike SandnerLOOKSfilm, ZDFinfoBearbeitung: Sabine ASSmann

programme.title: 3 1/2 hours / 3 1/2 Stunden
programme.desc: In the summer of 1961, the GDR design strengthened its barrier measures. A wall is pulled up between East and West Berlin, windows are barricaded, each loophole is closed. Nobody still guesses what difficult decision everyone will soon face. The GDR government raises a wall, East Berlin is sealed off. The travelers still have three and a half hours to get out in the west before the Grenzuertrieben. Their decision will have families apart, promising careers dangerous and is not least dependent on the train staff. programme.sub-title: Agriculture in change. Does the future of genetic engineering belong? / Landwirtschaft im Wandel. Gehort die Zukunft der Gentechnik?
programme.desc: The use of genetic engineering in agriculture is still controversial after almost 30 years. In addition to environmental concerns and the monopoly position of some fewer seed manufacturers, critics drove the long-term consequences to be tapped. In Europe, many consumers vehemently reject "genetic engineering on the plate". The cultivation of genetically connected plants has been cut in the EU, and in Austria they still have not come to the fields. The large agricultural -producing countries such as the USA, Canada, Brazil or India, on the other hand, rely flatly on it: worldwide generous plants are grown on around 200 million hectares of hectares. Minged into the genome, which means that plants become more resistant to climate extremes and males more resistance and their cultivation is less stressful. For some young farmers it is clear: in the future, agriculture does not have to contradict nature. After a few Durresommern, they were used more resistant NGT corn. But there is worry that in addition to the dependency on seed companies NGT seeds at the end of the day will be too expensive for small farmers. USA correspondent Thomas Langpaul is on local inspection in Oklahoma. The state in the country's central Suden pays to the fuided wheat producers and is one of the hotspots of the American agricultural industry. In addition to wheat, corn, soy and cotton is grown on the huge farms that still rely on classic genetic engineering (GMO). But here too, a rethink begins, because the consequences of climate change - such as extreme dur periods, soil erosion and thus falling streak - also present the large companies with enormous challenges. In 2021, the government dares an experiment: the entire country is to be switched to biological agriculture. Instead of a gradual transition, import and use of synthetic dung agents and pesticides are banned almost over night. Within a few months, the harvesting carrier breaks down drastically, the food prices shoot into the high, protests shocks the country. Correspondent Benedict Feichtner meets peasant families who have lost their livelihood as a result of the abrupt change. In the meantime, imported seeds and chemical sprays have been approved again, but at the same time a kind of countermovement has arisen: in training centers, small farmers learn today how they can sustainably operate organic farming using traditional and regenerative methods and thus escape the dependency on the large seed corporations. / Der Einsatz von Gentechnik in der Landwirtschaft ist - nach inzwischen fast 30 Jahren - immer noch umstritten. Kritiker fuhren neben Umweltbedenken und der Monopolstellung einiger weniger Saatgut-Hersteller vor allem die schwer abzuschatzenden Langzeitfolgen ins Treffen. In Europa lehnen viele Verbraucher "Gentechnik am Teller" vehement ab. Der Anbau gentechnisch veranderter Pflanzen ist in der EU stark eingeschrankt, in Österreich kommen sie bis heute nicht auf die Felder. Die groSSen agrarproduzierenden Lander wie die USA, Kanada, Brasilien oder auch Indien setzen hingegen flachendeckend darauf: weltweit werden auf rund 200 Millionen Hektar genmodifizierte Pflanzen angebaut.In Belgien spricht Korrespondent Johannes Perterer mit Wissenschaftlerinnen, die NGT - also die "Neue Gentechnik" - als groSSe Chance sehen: mit Entwicklungen wie der sogenannten "Genschere" sind prazisere Eingriffe ins Erbgut moglich, wodurch Pflanzen kunftig widerstandsfahiger gegen Klimaextreme und Schadlinge werden und ihr Anbau die Boden weniger belastet. Fur einige junge Bauern steht fest: in Zukunft muss Landwirtschaft nicht im Widerspruch zur Natur stehen. Nach einigen Durresommern wurden sie resistenteren NGT-Mais einsetzen. Doch es bleibt die Sorge, dass neben der Abhangigkeit von Saatgutkonzernen NGT-Saatgut am Ende des Tages fur kleine Bauern zu teuer sein wird.USA-Korrespondent Thomas Langpaul ist auf Lokalaugenschein in Oklahoma unterwegs. Der Bundesstaat im zentralen Suden des Landes zahlt zu den fuhrenden Weizenproduzenten und ist einer der Hotspots der amerikanischen Agrarindustrie. Auf den riesigen Farmen, die nach wie vor auf die klassische Gentechnik (GMO) setzen, wird neben Weizen vor allem Mais, Soja und Baumwolle angebaut. Doch auch hier beginnt ein Umdenken, denn die Folgen des Klimawandels - wie extreme Durreperioden, Bodenerosion und damit sinkende Ertrage - stellen auch die GroSSbetriebe vor enorme Herausforderungen.In Sri Lanka wagt die Regierung 2021 ein Experiment: das gesamte Land soll auf biologische Landwirtschaft umgestellt werden. Anstatt eines schrittweisen Überganges werden Einfuhr und Verwendung synthetischer Dungemittel und Pestizide quasi uber Nacht verboten. Binnen weniger Monate brechen die Ernteertrage drastisch ein, die Lebensmittelpreise schieSSen in die Hohe, Proteste erschuttern das Land. Korrespondent Benedict Feichtner trifft Bauernfamilien, die als Folge des abrupten Umstiegs ihre Existenzgrundlage verloren haben. Inzwischen sind importiertes Saatgut und chemische Spritzmittel wieder zugelassen, doch gleichzeitig ist eine Art Gegenbewegung entstanden: in Schulungszentren lernen Kleinbauern heute, wie sie mit traditionellen und regenerativen Methoden Bio-Landwirtschaft nachhaltig betreiben und so aus der Abhangigkeit von den groSSen Saatgut-Konzernen entkommen konnen.

programme.desc: "As soon as the flies revolve around the soup, the romanticism at the farm catches up," says Tyrolean farmer and actor Tobias Moretti. programme.title: Traumschlosser und Ritterburgen
programme.desc: From Strudengau to the upper Muhlviertel - the castles and locksmith in the Oberosterreiche Danube region are preserved by their owners with foresight for the coming generations.1822 the Saxony -Coburg and Gotha Schloss Greinburg have acquired in Grein an der Donau. Erbprinz Hubertus von Sachsen-Coburg and Gotha visits the oldest residential castle in Austria several times a month. Further west is the alleged oldest city in Austria: Enns. Parts of the Castle Ennsegg. Just a few kilometers from the state capital Linz, the castle of the same name is located in the municipality of Steygg, on which Niklas Salm-Reifferscheidt has headed the forest and estate administration since 2009. Starhemberg Castle has been owned by the Starhemberg family in Eferding west of Linz for around 450 years. Today it houses the family museum and the museum of the city of Eferding, and it is the residence of today's owner Georg Adam Starhemberg. Altenhof Castle in the Upper Muhlviertel once hired as well as the Falkenstein Castle in the immediate vicinity to rule the powerful Falkensteiner. Schloss Altenhof and the Ruin Falkenstein have been owned by the Counts Salburg-Falkenstein for over 400 years. / Vom Strudengau bis ins Obere Muhlviertel - die Burgen und Schlosser in der oberosterreichischen Donauregion werden von ihren Besitzerinnen und Besitzern mit Weitblick fur die kommenden Generationen bewahrt.1822 hat die Familie Sachsen-Coburg und Gotha Schloss Greinburg in Grein an der Donau erworben. Erbprinz Hubertus von Sachsen-Coburg und Gotha besucht das alteste Wohnschloss Österreichs mehrmals im Monat. Weiter westlich befindet sich die vorgeblich alteste Stadt Österreichs: Enns. Als Teil der Stadtbefestigung dienten einst Teile der Anlage von Schloss Ennsegg. Nur wenige Kilometer von der Landeshauptstadt Linz entfernt befindet sich in der Stadtgemeinde Steyregg das gleichnamige Schloss, auf dem Niklas Salm-Reifferscheidt seit 2009 die Forst- und Gutsverwaltung leitet. Seit rund 450 Jahren ist Schloss Starhemberg in Eferding westlich von Linz im Besitz der furstlichen Familie Starhemberg. Heute beherbergt es das Familienmuseum, sowie das Museum der Stadt Eferding, und es ist der Wohnsitz des heutigen Besitzers Georg Adam Starhemberg. Schloss Altenhof im Oberen Muhlviertel gehorte einst wie auch die in der unmittelbaren Umgebung gelegene Burg Falkenstein zur Herrschaft der machtigen Falkensteiner. Seit uber 400 Jahren sind Schloss Altenhof und die Ruine Falkenstein im Besitz der Grafen Salburg-Falkenstein.

programme.desc: Schroffe Gebirgsformationen, eine einzigartige Kulturlandschaft mitten in einer nahezu unberuhrten Wildnis: In der neuen Universum-Folge erkundet Skilegende Hermann Maier eine ganz besondere Region im auSSersten Westen Österreichs: den Bregenzerwald.In prachtvollen Bildern zeigt Universum die Schonheit dieser Bergwelt mit seinen Talern, die langsam zum Bodensee abfallen. programme.title: Unbekanntes Arabien
programme.sub-title: Saudi Arabia - the West / Saudi-Arabien - Der Westen
programme.desc: Gender separation, full veiling of women, no cinemas, no theater, no pleasure. That sounds daunting at first. But what about society in the Islamic kingdom? How do the people live here, what trauma are they waiting for, what do they hope for from the future? In Dschidda, Saudi-Arabia's colorful city on the Red Sea, 18-year Jumana Chalid dreams of one day the first Saudi prima ball nerwoman. Huda Talbani whistles on the strict rules and has set up with her mobile pet service. The men, on the other hand, seem to stick to their traditions. The immediate close to Mecca makes Ali pilgrims at least once a year to the holiest state of Islam. There he finds peace and the confirmation of being on the right track. Das klingt erst einmal abschreckend. Doch wie steht es wirklich um die Gesellschaft in dem islamischen Konigreich? Wie leben die Menschen hier, wovon traumen sie, was erhoffen sie sich von der Zukunft? In Dschidda, Saudi-Arabiens buntester Stadt am Roten Meer, traumt die 18-jahrige Dschumana Chalid davon, eines Tages als erste saudische Primaballerina offentlich zu tanzen. Huda Talbani pfeift auf die strengen Regeln und hat sich mit ihrem mobilen Haustier-Service selbststandig gemacht. Die Manner dagegen, so hat es den Anschein, halten an ihren Traditionen fest. Die unmittelbare Nahe Dschiddas zu Mekka lasst Ali mindestens einmal im Jahr zur heiligsten Statte des Islams pilgern. Dort findet er Ruhe und die Bestatigung, auf dem richtigen Weg zu sein. Und in den Bergen der Provinz Asir suchen einige Manner sogar Zuflucht in den Traditionen ihrer Vorvater.

programme.title: Land der Berge
programme.desc: Hutten can also be monuments. Although they are mostly simple and functional, they still commit landscape and culture. Even on the high alpine mountain huts, times have changed: what was more recently a saving protective hut, for example, has often become a safe destination to be achieved today. The expectations of the guest have also changed. Today, some hikers are more like a chic Alpine hotel than a Spartan mattress camp. Whether in the Allgau, in the Ötztal or in Jachenau - the monument -friendly use of a historical hat is a special challenge for everyone. (2018) / Auch Hutten konnen Denkmaler sein. Obwohl sie meist einfach und zweckmaSSig sind, pragen sie dennoch Landschaft und Kultur. Das Spektrum ist groSS und reicht von der Alm- und Jagdhutte bis zur hochalpinen Berghutte. Selbst auf der hochalpinen Berghutte haben sich die Zeiten geandert: Was fruher beispielsweise eine rettende Schutzhutte war, ist heute oft ein gefahrlos zu erreichendes Ausflugsziel geworden.
